traverse_state_dict: traverse a pytorch state dict recursively invoking a visitor callback for each tensor element
set_element: set a value in a pytorch state dict at a nested object path key tuple
get_element: get a value from a pytorch state dict at a nested object path key tuple with optional default
print_tensor: print tensor sizes and types from a pytorch state dict using traverse_state_dict with print_tensor callback
test_traverse_state_dict: test traverse_state_dict on a nested pytorch state dict with tensors and lists
